texts.board.empty: nothing on the board yet: open a device first.
keyring.rule: keyring + {label}. a rule: drop a fragment on it.
texts.keyring.title: KEYRING
guard.empty: nothing on your keyring to try. read things: people leave clues.
guard.signal: {noun} wants a person at the keyboard, not a signal.
guard.notfragment: {label} is a key chip, not a password.
seal.key: sealed. it wants a key chip.
seal.sequence: sealed. the seal listens for signals, in some order.
seal.signal: the seal ignores fingers. it listens for signals.
trace.kick: TRACE 100%. {device} kicks you out. locked for {sec} s.
net.ghost: {name}: seen on a scan. connect to it from {link}.
wire.fixed: that one is a conduit, not a cable. bolted shut. work around it.
give.module: installed {module}. {name} is in your board's palette now.
keyring.card: keyring + {label}. a card: lock toys take it, once a try.
texts.watchdog.name: REGISTRY WATCHDOG
watchdog.frozen: {device} is frozen: the watchdog is sitting on it. wait for it to move on.
watchdog.drop: signal dropped: {device} is frozen. the watchdog is sitting on it.
watchdog.mute: {event}: nothing leaves {device} while the watchdog sits on it.
watchdog.here: {name}: here. just checking. moves on in {sec} s.
watchdog.away: {name}: on {at} now. moves on in {sec} s.
watchdog.walking: {name}: on its way to {to}. arrives in {sec} s.
texts.toy.rings.title: SHIELD RINGS
texts.toy.rings.hint: lock each ring when its gap reaches the port at the top · SPACE or LOCK
toy.rings.miss: shield {n} flinched. it spins the other way now.
texts.toy.cipher.title: CIPHER WHEEL
texts.toy.cipher.hint: turn the inner ring until the line reads right · ← → or drag · ENTER reads it out
texts.toy.cryptex.title: CRYPTEX
texts.toy.cryptex.hint: turn each ring to its letter · ← → pick a ring, ↑ ↓ turn it, or type · ENTER pulls
texts.toy.morse.title: MORSE LAMP
texts.toy.morse.hint: watch the lamp, then tap it back: short ·, long – · a pause ends a letter · ENTER sends
